responsibility: This file implements diagnostic support for pinpointing ranges within string literals, especially format strings. It provides format_string_diagnostic_t, which chooses primary and secondary source ranges, optional labels, notes, and fix-it replacements based on whether a substring location can be recovered, and it delegates substring-to-location resolution to the language hook through substring_loc::get_location. Its role is diagnostic presentation logic for warnings that need to highlight specific conversion specifiers or substrings inside possibly concatenated string literals.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/substring-locations.h, which declares substring_loc and format_string_diagnostic_t plus the frontend hook helper, this .cc file implements the diagnostic behavior itself: resolving substring locations through lang_hooks and choosing warning ranges, notes, labels, and fix-it hints.
